$comment: Source context: bootstrap/src/agent_workflows.rs reads note and tools separately. The note explains workflow authorization; the tools define deferred skill discovery and reads. This comment is author metadata and is not part of either returned value.
note: Read a skill before its workflow. Each skill lists the tools its procedure uses; for Jazyk's own agents, reading it adds them to the tool catalog. Authorization still comes from the serving and its gates.

tools.name: list_jazyk_skills
tools.description: List built-in deferred Jazyk workflow skills, their triggers, required capabilities, the tools each uses, and source paths. Read-only. No graph or setId needed.

tools.name: read_jazyk_skill
tools.description: Read the exact instructions of one built-in Jazyk workflow skill before using it. When a tool you need is not in your catalog, read the skill that lists it: the reply names the skill's tools, and they are added to your catalog. A skill grants no permission or cost approval. No graph or setId needed.
